clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Three, two, one, go! They launch off the line!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Welcome to the midnight street race! Engines screaming!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Rockets off the start! What a getaway!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, the city is buzzing tonight! Let's ride!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Holeshot! He takes the early lead!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Perfect clutch control on that launch!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Wheelie! Front wheel high in the air!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He pops a wheelie down the straight!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Look at that balance! Pure showmanship!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Long wheelie! The crowd loves it!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Leaning hard into the corner! Knee on the ground!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Tucks in, leans over, and he's through!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: What a line through that bend! Smooth as silk!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Deep lean, sparks flying off the pegs!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Whoa! Just squeezed between two cars!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Inches from that truck! Near miss!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, my heart! That was so close!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Threads the gap in traffic! Unbelievable!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Amazing reflexes! He saw it just in time!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He's through! What a pass!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Up the inside! Takes the lead!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Blue bike passes Red! What a move!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Red bike strikes back! Back in front!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Late braking, perfect timing! Textbook pass!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Nitro! He hits the boost!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Boost engaged! He's rocketing away!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Perfect timing on that boost! Right out of the corner!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Blue flame! Full nitro!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Oh! He's down! Slides out on the corner!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Wipeout! But he's up and waving, he's okay!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Too much throttle on that turn! He'll be fine!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He's back on the bike! Not giving up!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Checkpoint! Time extended!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Through the checkpoint! Keep it pinned!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Great split time! He's ahead of the pace!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Checkpoint cleared! Halfway there!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Final stretch! Here comes the finish line!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Last corner! Everything on the line!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Tuck in and hold on! Full throttle!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Side by side down the final straight!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: It's a photo finish! Who got it?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: By the width of a tire! Incredible!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He wins it! What a ride!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Across the line first! Victory!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Champion of the streets tonight!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He rode like a legend! Flawless!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Just beaten at the line!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: So close! He'll get them next time!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Not tonight! But what a fight!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Listen to the crowd on the sidewalks!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Phones up, everyone's cheering!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The whole city is watching!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Weaving through the downtown streets!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He's saving the boost for later!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Neon lights blur past!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: You can feel an attack coming!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Plenty of road left in this race!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: What a launch from Blue!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Lightning reflexes! He was gone in a flash!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Can he catch the leader?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He's closing every corner! Watch out!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Traffic up ahead!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: This is where nerves count! Pick your gap!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Did you see that wheelie?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: I did! Two whole blocks on one wheel!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The crowd is going crazy!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: They love the speed tonight!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Is he saving his nitro?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Smart rider! He's waiting for the straight!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Huge near miss there!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: My heart is pounding! What reflexes!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He's right on the back wheel!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: The pressure is enormous!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Checkpoint coming up!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He needs a clean run through here!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: What a lean through that corner!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Knee down, perfect line! Beautiful!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Final stretch, they're side by side!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: This is going right to the line!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He went down, but he's back up!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Tough rider! Never quits!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The Red bike is fighting back!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He's not giving up without a battle!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Look at those sparks!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Leaning so far the pegs are scraping!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Is this the race of the night?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Easily! What a show!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Another pass!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He's carving through everybody!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The lead changed again!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Three leaders in one lap! Incredible!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Nitro on both bikes!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: It's a pure drag race now!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: That was a tight gap!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He threaded the needle! Wow!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: And that's the finish!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: What a race! I loved every second!
